findings.ac: Cron pre-flight exit status distinguishable from infrastructure failure
findings.text: Only the diverged path is asserted at process level (BT170_CronPreflight.test.js spawns run-job-ingestion.js and expects exit code 3). The unreachable path is asserted only as the in-process return value exitCode 4; no test spawns the worker against an unreachable or erroring DB and asserts the process exit is 4, so the `process.exitCode = res.exitCode` mapping for infrastructure is unproven.

findings.ac: Guard skips with warning on fork PR when credential absent; hard-fails otherwise
findings.text: BT170_DriftGuardCli.test.js covers only DRIFT_GUARD_FORK_PR='true' (skip, exit 0) and 'false' (MISCONFIGURATION, exit 4). The unset-variable case (the local default, runGuard deletes it) with no credential, and the partial-credential case (URL set, key absent, fork true or false) have no assertion, so a regression from `=== 'true'` to `!== 'false'` or to a one-credential check would pass every test.
